components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-primary{font:500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--brand,#176748);color:#fff;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:42px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s}.ds-primary:hover{background:#105337}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary{font:500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#172a25);border:1px solid var(--line,#dce5dd);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 16px;min-height:42px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s}.ds-secondary:hover{background:#edf3ed}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font:12px 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#172a25)}.ds-field input{font:13px 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#172a25);background:var(--surface,#fff);border:1px solid var(--line,#dce5dd);border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px;caret-color:var(--brand,#176748)}.ds-field input:hover{border-color:#b5c7ba}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Selected navigation inside the forest sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--sidebar,#102c22);padding:18px;display:grid;gap:5px;max-width:240px}.ds-nav button{font:500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;background:transparent;color:#c2d8c9;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:12px 15px;min-height:47px;text-align:start;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#244334}.ds-nav .ds-current,.ds-nav .ds-current:hover{background:var(--accent,#a9d8b3);color:var(--sidebar,#102c22)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #69a47a;outline-offset:3px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

components.name: Working Panel
components.css: .ds-panel{background:var(--surface,#fff);color:var(--ink,#172a25);border:1px solid var(--line,#dce5dd);border-radius:var(--radius,14px);padding:22px 24px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic','IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif}.ds-panel h2{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.6;margin:0}.ds-panel p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#52655d);margin:3px 0 0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

narrative.overview: Pale limestone working surfaces sit beside deep forest navigation. Alignment, rules, and restrained mint states organize dense operational information. This is the implemented original identity; shadcn research informed hierarchy only.

rules.name: The State Color Rule
rules.body: Pair status color with a written label; preserve explicit selected navigation contrast.

rules.name: The Numeric Alignment Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for amounts, totals, and metrics, retaining readable currency labels in both directions.

rules.name: The Direction Rule
rules.body: Use logical spacing and alignment so Arabic RTL and English LTR preserve the same hierarchy.

dos: Do preserve Arabic-first RTL and complete English layouts.
Do use borders, alignment, and spacing to group operational information.
Do keep written status labels beside color cues.
donts: Don't introduce ornamental dashboard shadows or marketing hero treatments.
Don't replace labeled sample data with implied real customer or revenue claims.
